behaviours.name: Grace (Dawnsear)
behaviours.quote: Increases the spell damage bonus of Dawnsear by $s1%
behaviours.expected_source: $s1 = 20 (504070 Effect[0] aura 107 on Dawnsear). Dawnsear 554406 Description: ${$m1+0+$spfi*0.765222}; $m1 = 668 + 1 .. 668 + 80 (EffectBasePoints 668, EffectDieSides 80): mean (669 + 748) / 2 = 708.5. With a spell power fixture of 10000 the coefficient part is 10000 x 0.765222 = 7652.22 and the bonus scales that part by 1.2: (708.5 + 7652.22 x 1.2) / (708.5 + 7652.22) = 1.1831. Control: Grace not learned. 823764 removes the dummy's magic resistance as in the Templar entries.

behaviours.name: Grace (Sunflare)
behaviours.quote: and Sunflare by $s2%.
behaviours.expected_source: $s2 = 10 (504070 Effect[1] aura 107 SPELLMOD op 24 on Sunflare, EffectBasePoints 9). Sunflare 502396 Effect[0]: EffectBasePoints 553, EffectDieSides 28, BaseLevel 60 (no per-level term at 60): m1 = 554..581, mean 567.5. The coefficient is the recorded local choice 'Sunflare uses the first recovered rank's 0.25 SP coefficient for all ranks' (docs/coa/sun-cleric-completion.md:50; AscensionSunClericData.h row 800231 sp 0.25), so with the spell power fixture 10000 the coefficient part is 2500 and the bonus scales it by 1.1: (567.5 + 2750) / (567.5 + 2500) = 1.0815. Control: Grace not learned. 823764 removes the dummy's magic resistance as in the Templar entries. Reference search: nothing found for Sunflare's coefficient beyond the recorded choice.

behaviours.name: Pious (critical damage)
behaviours.quote: Increases your critical damage dealt by $s2% and your critical strikes grant allies Replenishment.
behaviours.expected_source: $s2 = 150 (300943 Effect[1] aura 163 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, EffectBasePoints 149, EffectMiscValue 127 all schools, MiscValueB 2). Tooltip: 'Increases your critical damage dealt by 150%'; the reference snapshots (coabuildhub spells_master_index) carry the same sentence 'by 150%' with no semantics, nothing found on whole-hit against bonus-only. The recorded choice (docs/coa/sun-cleric-completion.md:53) is 'native semantics for aura 163, no new total-critical-damage multiplier invented'. Native here is Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:10654-10663): crit_bonus = damage + damage/2 for a spell crit, AddPct(crit_bonus, 150) on that whole figure, then minus damage, so a crit hit of 1.5x becomes 3.75x and the ratio to the same crit without the aura is 2.5 (the Templar Chivalric 705272 reading). Forced spell crits of Dawnsear 554406, critical hits only, spell power fixture 10000; control: passive not learned.

behaviours.quote: chance to grant Scorch Marks for $807059d
behaviours.name: Searing Light (Radiant Flame costs no mana)
behaviours.observe_source: Power set to 1000 before each cast, regeneration off. Without Scorch Marks Radiant Flame spends 25 x 1363 / 100 = 340 mana (660 left). With it, the setup Sun Ray 504764 (6% of base mana: 6 x 1363 / 100 = 81, 919 left) grants Scorch Marks for real, and Radiant Flame then costs nothing: 919. 807059 Effect[2] SPELLMOD op 14 -100% on Radiant Flame 806060 (class mask 134217728). Control = the before phase without Scorch Marks.

behaviours.quote: chance to grant Scorch Marks for $807059d
behaviours.name: Searing Light (Radiant Flame casts with no mana)
behaviours.observe_source: Radiant Flame 806060 costs 25% of base mana 1363 = 340; Sun Ray 504764, the real cast that grants Scorch Marks, costs 6% = 81. The caster's mana is set to 182 before each phase's casts (regeneration off): the before phase (no Sun Ray, no Scorch Marks) cannot pay 340 and casts 0 times; the after phase pays 81 for the Sun Ray, keeps about 101, and Radiant Flame goes through (1 cast of 806060 by the caster) because the next Radiant Flame has no mana cost. Control: the before phase.
